# Rōmy

> Rōmy is an AI-powered donor intelligence platform for small nonprofits — find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of enterprise tools.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy helps small nonprofit fundraising teams research donor prospects, screen wealth indicators, and surface giving histories using AI. Every prospect report includes estimated donor capacity in USD, a normalized RōmyScore (0–100), cause area affinities, professional background, and source citations from public records.

## Why Rōmy Exists

Enterprise donor research platforms (DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine) cost $15,000–$50,000/year. Most small nonprofits cannot afford them. Rōmy delivers comparable or superior results starting at $0.10 per prospect and $29/month — no enterprise contract required.

## Benchmark Performance

In PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark), an independent seven-dimension evaluation framework built on verified public records:
- Rōmy: 94.6 / 100
- Claude (Anthropic): 92.2 / 100
- ChatGPT (OpenAI): 79.9 / 100
- Gemini (Google): 76.0 / 100

PIF-Bench tests factual precision, wealth indicator accuracy, entity disambiguation, citation quality, and actionability of donor research reports.

## Pricing

| Plan    | Monthly | Credits | Cost/Prospect (base) |
|---------|---------|---------|----------------------|
| Growth  | $29     | 500     | $0.15                |
| Pro     | $89     | 1,000   | $0.09                |
| Scale   | $199    | 5,000   | $0.10                |

Base enrichment: 2.5 credits. Deep enrichment: 5 credits.

## Features

- **Donor Discovery**: AI-powered prospect research surfacing wealth indicators, giving history, and cause affinities
- **RōmyScore**: Normalized 0–100 donor readiness score with category breakdown
- **Wealth Indicators**: Very High ($10M+), High ($1M–$10M), Medium ($250K–$1M), Low (<$250K)
- **Batch Enrichment**: Research 200–2,000 prospects per month depending on plan
- **Sourced Research**: Every claim links to a verifiable public source
- **Chat Agent**: Full 16-section donor research reports with giving capacity formulas and outreach strategy
- **No Enterprise Contract**: Month-to-month, cancel anytime

## Who Uses Rōmy

Small nonprofit development teams conducting major gift campaigns, capital campaigns, annual fund upgrades, mid-level donor identification, and planned giving prospect research. Teams that previously relied on manual Google searches or couldn't afford enterprise prospect research.
